scope: DA16 targeted sweep (loop-8 must-fix): verify latest-reported-quarter revenue, GAAP net income, diluted EPS (GAAP and adjusted where stated), and period label/end date for ADP, CAH, BR, PPG, PGR, AXP, HBAN against primary sources (SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings releases, 10-Q/10-K, XBRL companyfacts). facts.claim: Q4 FY26 GAAP net income '~$1,013-1,062M range (qtr)' (dossier §4)
facts.dossier_location: dossiers/ADP.md §4, table row 'Q4 FY26 (Jun-26)', Net income column
facts.source: ADP 8-K Ex-99.1, Q4/FY2026 earnings release, filed 2026-07-29, accession 0000008670-26-000025; cross-checked against SEC XBRL companyfacts CIK0000008670 (FY26 total net earnings $4,413.5M minus 9-month YTD Jul25-Mar26 net earnings $3,434.9M = $978.6M)
facts.source_value: Net earnings (GAAP), Q4 FY26 = $978.6M (+7% YoY vs $910.6M in Q4 FY25)
facts.note: This is the flagged bug: the dossier's Q4 FY26 net-income cell is not a real figure but a re-paste of the Q1 FY26 ($1,013.0M) and Q2 FY26 ($1,062.0M) net-income values shown two rows above in the same table. The correct Q4 FY26 GAAP net income is $978.6M, +7% YoY -- not the $1,013-1,062M range stated. FY26 full-year total ($4,413.5M) and GAAP diluted EPS ($2.45) elsewhere in the same row are correct and internally consistent with the corrected $978.6M figure (978.6+1013.0+1062.0+1359.8=4,413.4M, i.e. the annual total in the dossier is right; only the Q4 quarterly net-income cell is wrong).
